name: add_notification_webhook_channel
description: Add a webhook delivery channel to a small notification dispatcher, spanning channels.py (new handler) and its registry.register call
prompts: This is a tiny notification dispatcher: registry.py holds a name -> handler map (register/handler_for), channels.py defines the handlers (send_email, send_sms) and registers them under 'email'/'sms', and dispatcher.py looks a channel up and calls it. Add a third channel: send_webhook(recipient, message) in channels.py that validates recipient starts with 'http://' or 'https://' (raise ValueError otherwise, mirroring send_sms's validation style) and returns a receipt dict shaped like the others ({'channel': 'webhook', 'to': recipient, 'status': 'sent', 'body': message}), registered under the name 'webhook' so `dispatch('webhook', url, msg)` and `dispatch_all('webhook', urls, msg)` both work exactly like the existing channels.
